newsitem.title: USA: Nissan initiates airbag safety effort.
newsitem.headline: Nissan initiates airbag safety effort.

text.p: Nissan Motor Corp U.S.A., a unit of Nissan Motor Co Ltd, said Tuesday it began a voluntary effort to remind owners of about 1,517,106 Nissan vehicles and 227,189 Infiniti vehicles equipped with passenger airbags of safety information relating to their operation.

Nissan and Infiniti are providing child seat and seat-belt information along with an airbag warning label that soon will be required for new vehicles. It is asking owners to affix the airbag label to a conspicuous location in the vehicle or to attach it to the owner's manual as a further safety reminder.
